Finds the bodies of a physics world that touch a box, which is lined up with the world unless it is given a turn. The bodies are kept in the order they were made; read them with `GetPhysicsOverlap` until the next overlap query. The query sees the bodies as `PhysicsUpdate` last left them. A body that the program moved since then is only found at its new place after the next `PhysicsUpdate`, and `PhysicsUpdate 0` takes the moves over without a step.
@param x The middle of the box, x.
@param y The middle of the box, y.
@param z The middle of the box, z.
@param half_x Half of the width of the box, more than 0.
@param half_y Half of the height of the box, more than 0.
@param half_z Half of the depth of the box, more than 0.
@param pitch The turn of the box around x, in degrees, as `TurnEntity` takes them. 0 (default) is not turned.
@param yaw The turn around y, in degrees. 0 (default) is not turned.
@param roll The turn around z, in degrees. 0 (default) is not turned.
@param mask_low The layers to look at, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask (bit n is layer n). -1 (default) looks at all layers.
@param mask_high The layers 32 to 63, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask. -1 (default) looks at all layers.
@param sensors 1 also finds sensors (see `PhysicsSensor`); 0 (default) leaves them out.
@param world The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world.
@returns How many bodies touch the box.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
